svg.title: Review a saved Jupyter AI conversation beside its native Git repair diff
svg.desc: 1: Compare the original mean on the left with the repaired function on the right in the Git diff. 2: Inspect inverse-variance weights and the weighted-sum return formula. 3: The saved conversation reports 12 passed and unchanged tests; rerun the tests to verify. 4: Check the OpenCode client and CPD Qwen model selection shown below the saved chat.
